title:
Comment of Deborah Burns in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 10/19/2026

documents.name: 151672.txt
documents.text:
Deborah Burns, Seattle, WA.
Hello,

I am against building an underwater data center in the Bay of Fundy, and submitting my comment to docket P-15424-000.

These pristine ocean waters must be allowed to remain free from human development so that both the sea life, especially the critically endangered North Atlantic Right Whales, and the environment that it depends on are protected.  

NO data center.

Thank you.
